const stage=document.getElementById('stage'),ctx=stage.getContext('2d');let mon='Reedling',anim='Idle',t=0,playing=true,speed=1,last=performance.now();let loaded={},parts=new Map();
const SEL={monster:document.getElementById('monster'),animation:document.getElementById('animation'),seek:document.getElementById('seek'),speed:document.getElementById('speed')};
function init(){for(const name of Object.keys(LIBRARY)){const opt=document.createElement('option');opt.textContent=name;opt.value=name;SEL.monster.add(opt);const im=new Image();im.src=LIBRARY[name].texture;loaded[name]=im;}SEL.monster.value=mon;chooseMonster();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function chooseMonster(){mon=SEL.monster.value;parts.clear();SEL.animation.innerHTML='';const a=LIBRARY[mon].animations;for(const name of Object.keys(a)){const opt=document.createElement('option');opt.value=name;opt.textContent=name+' ('+a[name].toFixed(2)+'s)';SEL.animation.add(opt);}anim=a.Idle!==undefined?'Idle':Object.keys(a)[0];SEL.animation.value=anim;t=0;showMeta();}
function showMeta(){let d=LIBRARY[mon];document.getElementById('metadata').textContent=d.spine.bones.length+' bones · '+d.spine.slots.length+' slots · '+Object.keys(d.animations).length+' animations';}
function span(){return Math.max(.1,LIBRARY[mon].animations[anim]||1)}
SEL.monster.onchange=chooseMonster;SEL.animation.onchange=()=>{anim=SEL.animation.value;t=0;showMeta()};SEL.speed.oninput=()=>{speed=parseFloat(SEL.speed.value);document.getElementById('speed-label').textContent=speed.toFixed(2)+'×'};
const toggle=document.getElementById('toggle');toggle.onclick=()=>{playing=!playing;toggle.textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play'};document.getElementById('restart').onclick=()=>t=0;document.getElementById('step').onclick=()=>{playing=false;toggle.textContent='Play';t=(t+1/30)%span()};
SEL.seek.oninput=()=>{t=parseFloat(SEL.seek.value)*span();playing=false;toggle.textContent='Play'};
document.getElementById('screenshot').onclick=()=>{const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=stage.toDataURL('image/png');a.download='TLL_'+mon+'_'+anim+'_'+t.toFixed(2)+'.png';a.click()};
function point(keys,frame,def){return keys.map((k,i)=>frame?.[k] ?? def[i]);}
function interpolate(keyframes,time,keys,def,angular=false){if(!keyframes||!keyframes.length||time<(keyframes[0].time||0))return def;if(keyframes.length===1||time>=(keyframes[keyframes.length-1].time||0))return point(keys,keyframes[keyframes.length-1],def);let ix=0;while(ix+1<keyframes.length-1&&time>=(keyframes[ix+1].time||0))ix++;const a=keyframes[ix],b=keyframes[ix+1];let f=(time-(a.time||0))/Math.max(.00001,(b.time||0)-(a.time||0));if(a.curve==='stepped')f=0;return keys.map((key,i)=>{let va=a[key]??def[i],vb=b[key]??def[i];if(angular&&key==='angle')vb=va+((vb-va+540)%360)-180;return va+(vb-va)*f})}
function matrices(a,b){return [a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[2],a[0]*b[1]+a[1]*b[3],a[2]*b[0]+a[3]*b[2],a[2]*b[1]+a[3]*b[3]]}function mv(m,v){return [m[0]*v[0]+m[1]*v[1],m[2]*v[0]+m[3]*v[1]]}
function world(d,anim,t){let result={};const changes=d.animations[anim].bones||{};for(const b of d.bones){let v=changes[b.name]||{};let rot=interpolate(v.rotate,t,['angle'],[0],true)[0],tr=interpolate(v.translate,t,['x','y'],[0,0]),ss=interpolate(v.scale,t,['x','y'],[1,1]);const r=(b.rotation||0)+rot,ang=r*Math.PI/180,c=Math.cos(ang),s=Math.sin(ang),local=[c*(b.scaleX||1)*ss[0],-s*(b.scaleY||1)*ss[1],s*(b.scaleX||1)*ss[0],c*(b.scaleY||1)*ss[1]];let pos=[(b.x||0)+tr[0],(b.y||0)+tr[1]],mat=local;if(b.parent&&result[b.parent]){const p=result[b.parent];let delta=mv(p.mat,pos);pos=[p.pos[0]+delta[0],p.pos[1]+delta[1]];mat=matrices(p.mat,local);}result[b.name]={pos,mat};}return result}
function partFor(name,region){const key=name+'/'+region;if(parts.has(key))return parts.get(key);const entry=LIBRARY[name],r=entry.regions[region],img=loaded[name];if(!r||!img.complete||!img.naturalWidth)return null;
const orig=r.orig||r.size,off=r.offset||[0,0],w=r.size[0],h=r.size[1],rot=r.rotate;const pw=rot?h:w,ph=rot?w:h,ax=entry.atlasSize[0],ay=entry.atlasSize[1];const x=r.xy[0],y=r.xy[1];const x0=Math.round(x*img.width/ax),y0=Math.round(y*img.height/ay),x1=Math.round((x+pw)*img.width/ax),y1=Math.round((y+ph)*img.height/ay);
const piece=document.createElement('canvas');piece.width=w;piece.height=h;const pc=piece.getContext('2d');if(rot){pc.translate(0,h);pc.rotate(-Math.PI/2);pc.drawImage(img,x0,y0,x1-x0,y1-y0,0,0,h,w)}else pc.drawImage(img,x0,y0,x1-x0,y1-y0,0,0,w,h);
const full=document.createElement('canvas');full.width=orig[0];full.height=orig[1];full.getContext('2d').drawImage(piece,off[0],orig[1]-off[1]-h);parts.set(key,full);return full;}
function slotAttachment(ch,t,defaultName){let curr=defaultName;for(const f of ch?.attachment||[]){if((f.time||0)>t)break;curr=f.name;}return curr}

function meshPoints(att,slotBone,bones,deform){
 const uv=att.uvs||[], verts=att.vertices||[], count=uv.length/2, out=[];
 if(verts.length===count*2){
   for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
     const x=verts[2*i]+(deform[2*i]||0),y=verts[2*i+1]+(deform[2*i+1]||0);
     const p=mv(slotBone.mat,[x,y]);out.push([slotBone.pos[0]+p[0],slotBone.pos[1]+p[1]]);
   }
 }else{
   let at=0,di=0;
   for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
     const influences=verts[at++]|0;let x=0,y=0;
     for(let j=0;j<influences;j++){
       const bi=verts[at++]|0, vx=verts[at++]+(deform[di++]||0),vy=verts[at++]+(deform[di++]||0),w=verts[at++];
       const bn=bones[window.__boneNames[bi]];
       if(bn){const p=mv(bn.mat,[vx,vy]);x+=(bn.pos[0]+p[0])*w;y+=(bn.pos[1]+p[1])*w;}
     }
     out.push([x,y]);
   }
 }
 return out;
}
function meshDeform(anim,skinName,slotName,attachmentName,time){
 const keys=anim.deform?.[skinName]?.[slotName]?.[attachmentName]||[];
 if(!keys.length)return [];
 let prev=keys[0],next=null;
 if(time<(prev.time||0))return [];
 for(let i=1;i<keys.length;i++){if(keys[i].time>time){next=keys[i];break;}prev=keys[i];}
 const size=Math.max((prev.offset||0)+(prev.vertices||[]).length,next?(next.offset||0)+(next.vertices||[]).length:0);
 const a=Array(size).fill(0),b=Array(size).fill(0);
 (prev.vertices||[]).forEach((v,i)=>a[i+(prev.offset||0)]=v);
 if(!next)return a;
 (next.vertices||[]).forEach((v,i)=>b[i+(next.offset||0)]=v);
 const f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(time-prev.time)/(next.time-prev.time)));
 return a.map((v,i)=>v+(b[i]-v)*f);
}
function drawMesh(att,sprite,slotBone,bones,anim,slot,name,sc,ox,oy){
 const deform=meshDeform(anim,'default',slot,name,t);
 const pts=meshPoints(att,slotBone,bones,deform),uv=att.uvs||[],tris=att.triangles||[];
 const sw=sprite.width,sh=sprite.height;
 const projected=pts.map(p=>[ox+sc*p[0],oy-sc*p[1]]);
 for(let k=0;k+2<tris.length;k+=3){
  const ia=tris[k],ib=tris[k+1],ic=tris[k+2];if(!projected[ia]||!projected[ib]||!projected[ic])continue;
  const a=projected[ia],b=projected[ib],c=projected[ic];
  const u=[uv[ia*2]*sw,(1-uv[ia*2+1])*sh],v=[uv[ib*2]*sw,(1-uv[ib*2+1])*sh],w=[uv[ic*2]*sw,(1-uv[ic*2+1])*sh];
  const det=(v[0]-u[0])*(w[1]-u[1])-(w[0]-u[0])*(v[1]-u[1]);if(Math.abs(det)<1e-8)continue;
  const A=((b[0]-a[0])*(w[1]-u[1])-(c[0]-a[0])*(v[1]-u[1]))/det;
  const C=((c[0]-a[0])*(v[0]-u[0])-(b[0]-a[0])*(w[0]-u[0]))/det;
  const B=((b[1]-a[1])*(w[1]-u[1])-(c[1]-a[1])*(v[1]-u[1]))/det;
  const D=((c[1]-a[1])*(v[0]-u[0])-(b[1]-a[1])*(w[0]-u[0]))/det;
  const E=a[0]-A*u[0]-C*u[1],F=a[1]-B*u[0]-D*u[1];
  ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(...a);ctx.lineTo(...b);ctx.lineTo(...c);ctx.closePath();ctx.clip();
  ctx.setTransform(A,B,C,D,E,F);ctx.drawImage(sprite,0,0);ctx.restore();
 }
}

function render(){const entry=LIBRARY[mon],data=entry.spine,worldBones=world(data,anim,t),skin=(data.skins[0]||{}).attachments||{},slotChanges=(data.animations[anim].slots||{}),s=data.skeleton||{};
ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.fillStyle='#111b2c';ctx.fillRect(0,0,stage.width,stage.height);
window.__boneNames=data.bones.map(b=>b.name);
let sc=Math.min(stage.width*.83/Math.max(1,s.width||600),stage.height*.83/Math.max(1,s.height||600),1),cx=(s.x||0)+(s.width||600)/2,cy=(s.y||0)+(s.height||600)/2,ox=stage.width/2-sc*cx,oy=stage.height/2+sc*cy;
// Render the same slot order encoded in the original skeleton.
for(const slot of data.slots){const name=slotAttachment(slotChanges[slot.name],t,slot.attachment);if(!name)continue;const att=(skin[slot.name]||{})[name],b=worldBones[slot.bone];if(!att||!b)continue;if(att.type&&att.type!=='region'&&att.type!=='mesh')continue;const reg=att.path||att.name||name;const sprite=partFor(mon,reg);if(!sprite)continue;if(att.type==='mesh'){drawMesh(att,sprite,b,worldBones,data.animations[anim],slot.name,name,sc,ox,oy);continue;}const aw=(att.width||sprite.width)/sprite.width*(att.scaleX??1),ah=(att.height||sprite.height)/sprite.height*(att.scaleY??1),angle=(att.rotation||0)*Math.PI/180,co=Math.cos(angle),si=Math.sin(angle),mat=matrices(b.mat,[co*aw,-si*ah,si*aw,co*ah]);const delta=mv(b.mat,[att.x||0,att.y||0]),pos=[b.pos[0]+delta[0],b.pos[1]+delta[1]];
const proj=(ix,iy)=>{const v=mv(mat,[ix-sprite.width/2,sprite.height/2-iy]);return [ox+sc*(pos[0]+v[0]),oy-sc*(pos[1]+v[1])]};const p0=proj(0,0),px=proj(sprite.width,0),py=proj(0,sprite.height);
let alpha=1;const col=(slot.color||'ffffffff'),col2=(att.color||'ffffffff');if(col.length===8)alpha*=parseInt(col.slice(6,8),16)/255;if(col2.length===8)alpha*=parseInt(col2.slice(6,8),16)/255;ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.setTransform((px[0]-p0[0])/sprite.width,(px[1]-p0[1])/sprite.width,(py[0]-p0[0])/sprite.height,(py[1]-p0[1])/sprite.height,p0[0],p0[1]);ctx.drawImage(sprite,0,0);}
ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function loop(now){const dt=Math.min(.2,Math.max(0,(now-last)/1000));last=now;if(playing)t=(t+dt*speed)%span();render();SEL.seek.value=(t/span());document.getElementById('clock').textContent=t.toFixed(2)+'s / '+span().toFixed(2)+'s';requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
init();
</script></body></html>
